compound.name: camphor
compound.one_liner: Convulsant bicyclic ketone in sage (5-20 % of oil) and rosemary (13-21 % Spanish type).

identity.note: Stereo-unspecified record; enantiomer in sage/rosemary not resolved here.

processing_stability.volatility: steam-volatile: recovered in hydro/steam-distilled essential oil (see occurrence sources)
processing_stability.note: Solubility and heat-stability values not sourced in this pass.

safety_flags.detail: EMA rosemary report: clinically insignificant signs around 5 mg/kg, manifest toxicity above 30 mg/kg; seizures in children reported [12]. EMA sage report: camphor 7-50 % in commercial sage oils [1].
safety_flags.threshold_or_limit: toxicity thresholds as reported by EMA (not use levels): ~5 mg/kg insignificant; >30 mg/kg manifest toxicity
safety_flags.source_citation: EMA/HMPC assessment reports on rosemary (2024) and sage (2016)

compound.teaching_note: Camphor links two greenhouse herbs through one hazard; it is why EMA restricts rosemary oil in children [12].
gaps: No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
